Fill in each code chunk. Answers are in the [Week 5 slides](https://haleydaarstad.com/pol051-f26-section/slides/lec-5.html).

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

options(scipen = 999)  # turns off scientific notations like 1e+40

rm(list=ls(all=TRUE))

library(tidyverse)
library(sjPlot)
library(zoo)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(plotly)

# NHL player stats, 2023-24 regular season (goalies and missing positions removed)
hockey <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hbdaarstad/NHL-22-24-Season-Data/main/hockey_stats.csv") |>
  filter(!is.na(position), position != "G")

# Google Trends: monthly U.S. search interest (0-100), 2004 to 2026
google_trends <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hbdaarstad/NHL-22-24-Season-Data/main/google_trends.csv")

# Total goals for each team by position (C, D, L, R) plus a Total column
hockey_goals <- hockey |>
  group_by(team, position) |>
  summarise(goals = sum(goals, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = position, values_from = goals, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(Total = rowSums(across(-team)))

# The 16 teams that made the 2024 Stanley Cup playoffs
playoffs_2024 <- c("FLA", "BOS", "TOR", "TBL", "NYR", "WSH", "CAR", "NYI",
                   "DAL", "VGK", "COL", "WPG", "VAN", "NSH", "EDM", "LAK")

def.chunk.hook  <- knitr::knit_hooks$get("chunk")
knitr::knit_hooks$set(chunk = function(x, options) {
  x <- def.chunk.hook(x, options)
  paste0("\n \\", "tiny","\n\n", x, "\n\n \\tiny")})
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```
